opening.text: I'm a 24-year-old woman of Southeast Asian background. I've had blisters on my skin for 2 months; some are small and some are large, and they're itchy. I also have a rash on my cheeks, raw sores inside my cheeks, on the roof of my mouth and on my lips, and I've been losing hair.
